title: Fee Schedule: Term Length, Policy Fee, Cancellation Fee and Minimum Earned Premium by Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Package
content:
The coverage package of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy sets the length of each policy term, the policy fee billed for each term, the package's cancellation fee and the package's minimum earned premium.

| Item | Cardinal Auto Essential | Cardinal Auto Basic | Cardinal Auto Standard | Cardinal Auto Plus | Cardinal Auto Preferred | Cardinal Auto Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Policy term, months | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 12 |
| Policy fee per term, USD | 25.00 | 20.00 | 12.00 | 12.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Cancellation fee, USD | 50.00 | 50.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Minimum earned premium, USD | 75.00 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

## What each figure is

- **Policy term.** Every package runs six-month terms except Cardinal Auto Premier, which runs twelve-month terms.
- **Policy fee.** Charged once per term, at issuance and again at each renewal. It is billed separately and is not premium. Cardinal Auto Preferred and Cardinal Auto Premier carry no policy fee.
- **Cancellation fee.** The package's fee associated with a cancellation the named insured requests during the term.
- **Minimum earned premium.** The least premium the company retains for a term cancelled at the insured's request. It is 75.00 on Cardinal Auto Essential, 50.00 on Cardinal Auto Basic and 0.00 on the four higher packages.
